title: Floating Machi Koro-style central illustration spec
purpose: Central illustration for a green Machi Koro establishment card.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only a central content illustration to composite onto a blank card template.
integration_context.background_requirement: Native RGBA transparency is mandatory. Outside the requested miniature and its integral base every pixel must have alpha=0. Do not render a checkerboard, field, gradient, glow, halo, vignette, shadow, scenery, sky, card furniture, text, coin, icon, or frame.
integration_context.text_policy: No text or text-like content: no letters, numbers, words, prices, labels, signs, graffiti, license plates, or pseudo-glyphs. The requested wordless brand mark is the only exception.

style_goal.primary_rule: Match cute simplified original Machi Koro establishment art without copying a specific illustration.
style_goal.core_formula: Cute simplified board-game miniature plus a familiar Siberian Russian supermarket.

content.subject: A small iconic Siberian Мария-Ра neighbourhood supermarket.
content.description: A low broad regional supermarket with a sunny yellow fascia, leaf-green trim and plinth, pale gray wall panels, large simple blue-gray windows, centered automatic doors, a shallow canopy, and one small wordless green-and-yellow rounded leaf/flower brand mark. The front faces slightly right, the building's left side is visible, and depth recedes toward image left.
content.desired_read: A recognisable Мария-Ра grocery rendered as a compact floating Machi Koro-style miniature.
recognition_details: sunny yellow fascia with strong leaf-green trim
one small wordless green-and-yellow leaf/flower mark and no lettering
broad simple glazing, automatic doors, and a shallow canopy
content.miniature_base: A compact rounded patch of worn asphalt with a short concrete curb and a few sparse grass tufts, fully isolated on transparency.
simplify: facade into chunky yellow, leaf-green, gray, and glass-blue masses
glazing and sparse grass into a few graphic shapes
omit: all words, letters, numbers, signage, posters, labels, pseudo-writing, people, cars, shopping carts, product packaging, and advertising
all surrounding scenery, realistic textures, dramatic lighting, and full-card composition
content.target_impression: The same whimsical illustrator who drew classic Machi Koro establishments has drawn a deadpan, recognisable Мария-Ра grocery.

final_prompt_summary: Generate only the described compact floating miniature: a low yellow-and-leaf-green Мария-Ра neighbourhood supermarket on a small asphalt-and-curb slab. Its front facade faces slightly right, its left side is visible, and depth recedes toward image left; do not show its right side or depth receding right. Use clean outlines, chunky simple shapes, sparse detail, and flat graphic shading in a cute Machi Koro board-game style; no photorealism. Native RGBA transparency is mandatory, with alpha=0 outside the miniature. Include exactly one small wordless green-and-yellow leaf/flower brand mark and no brand text. Do not create a card, background, sky, cast shadow, scenery, people, vehicles, product packages, letters, numbers, words, signs, labels, graffiti, or pseudo-text.
